newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen heading up through resistance. [CORRECTED 08:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen heading up through resistance. [CORRECTED 08:35 GMT]

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
Cocoa looks good, and is likely to be preparing for an assault on resistance as it moves to higher levels, technical analysts said.
Traders said benchmark September was due 15-20 stg higher (Corrects figure).
There is resistance immediately above 1,140 stg, independent analyst Elli Gifford said. "If the CSCE's anything to go by, it should manage to get past it," she said.
The next target would then be 1,165. "In the longer term I can see it up to 1,270," she said. "If we do get through the highs... the picture will change."
New York cocoa futures rocketed to new eight-year highs on Monday as commodity funds bought heavy amid bullish technical indicators and a supportive long-term fundamental outlook, dealers said.
